scope: Active P1/P2/P3 only. For this medical device issuer, scope captures active interventional pivotal/IDE/post-approval clinical studies of AtriCure-owned devices. Observational registries are excluded.

ctgov.note: ctgov sponsor query returned only legacy COMPLETED/WITHDRAWN/UNKNOWN trials; current active studies were identified via the AtriCure clinical-evidence webpage and cross-referenced to ctgov NCT IDs individually.

pipeline.modality: Implantable surgical device (left atrial appendage exclusion clip)

indications.indication: Prophylactic stroke reduction in cardiac surgery patients (with or without AF)
indications.trial_name: LeAAPS (Left Atrial Appendage Exclusion for Prophylactic Stroke Reduction)
indications.trial_design: Randomized IDE pivotal trial, ~6,500 patients, evaluating prophylactic AtriClip use during cardiac surgery to reduce ischemic stroke or systemic embolism
indications.trial_status: Enrollment complete; in follow-up (per company website)

indications.indication: Atrial fibrillation prevention after cardiac surgery (combined with Isolator Synergy EnCompass)
indications.trial_design: Randomized controlled trial of Isolator Synergy EnCompass plus AtriClip vs. control to prevent post-operative AF in patients undergoing cardiac surgery

pipeline.target: Cardiac tissue (posterior left atrial wall, epicardial RF ablation)

indications.indication: Long-standing persistent atrial fibrillation (Convergent hybrid procedure)
indications.trial_design: Prospective post-approval study of EPi-Sense / EPi-Sense ST device for long-standing persistent AF; required by FDA following PMA approval
key_milestones: FDA PMA approved 2021 for long-standing persistent AF; PAS active

pipeline.target: Cardiac tissue (Maze procedure cryoablation) and intercostal nerves (cryo nerve block)

indications.indication: Persistent and long-standing persistent atrial fibrillation during concomitant on-pump cardiac surgery
indications.trial_design: Bayesian adaptive pivotal IDE trial of cryoICE for persistent and long-standing persistent AF during concomitant cardiac surgery
indications.trial_status: Enrollment complete; results published 2025; supports labeling expansion

pipeline.target: Cardiac tissue (pulmonary vein isolation, left atrial ablation)

indications.trial_design: Single-arm investigational study of Isolator Synergy device for inappropriate sinus tachycardia
indications.trial_status: Enrollment complete; in follow-up (per company website)

commercial_product.note: AtriCure markets a portfolio of FDA-cleared/approved surgical ablation and LAA-exclusion devices including the Isolator Synergy bipolar RF ablation system, the AtriClip LAA Exclusion System (multiple variants), the cryoICE cryoablation platform (cryoICE BOX, cryoSPHERE, cryoSPHERE+ for cryo nerve block), and the EPi-Sense / EPi-Sense ST devices used in the Convergent hybrid procedure for long-standing persistent AF (FDA PMA approved 2021).
key_franchises: Isolator Synergy / EnCompass (surgical ablation for AF)
cryoICE platform (cryoablation and post-surgical pain management)
EPi-Sense (Convergent procedure for long-standing persistent AF)

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: WITHDRAWN — legacy AtriCure Bipolar persistent AF P3
